title: A visitor to flowweb.app sees a clean public homepage that says what FlowWeb is and signs them in or up there: email and password a password manager can save, an emailed link, or Google
description: The Owner wants FlowWeb to be something he can hand to friends or market, so the signed-out flowweb.app should be a homepage that doubles as the login portal, not a bare one-field card. Today a signed-out visitor sees hosted/SignIn.tsx: a centred card that only sends a one-time email link to an existing owner. Replace it with packages/web/src/home/HomePage.tsx, built only from the FlowWeb token layer (12px cards, 8px inner panes, 6 to 8px controls): a short pitch of what FlowWeb does with a quiet visual of a flow, and an account card with Sign in and Create account. Sign in takes email and password (autocomplete username/email and current-password, a show-password toggle), Create account takes email and a new password (autocomplete new-password) and says to check email when confirmation is needed, plus Email me a sign-in link, Continue with Google (hidden when authMethods.google is false), and Forgot password, which sends a reset email. When a reset link lands, the same page shows Choose a new password. Errors show our own sentence in an alert. The auth calls come from hosted/auth.ts (row FW-C-080); this row builds no auth backend. No em dashes in the copy.
acceptance: packages/web/src/home/HomePage.tsx exports HomePage, and App.tsx shows it to a signed-out visitor on the site in place of SignIn
The page has one h1, a Sign in path and a Create account path, and no em dash anywhere in its text
Sign in has an email field with autocomplete username or email and a password field with autocomplete current-password, a show-password toggle, and calls signInWithPassword(email, password)
Create account has a password field with autocomplete new-password, calls signUp(email, password), and says to check email when it resolves needsConfirm
Email me a sign-in link calls sendLink(email) and Forgot password calls sendPasswordReset(email); both then say to check email
Continue with Google calls signInWithGoogle() and is not shown when authMethods.google is false
A thrown error's message shows in an alert; a notice passed in shows on the page
With recovery set, the page shows Choose a new password with a new-password field and calls setPassword
